options.B: Causal self-attention and a position-wise feed-forward network.

questions.text: A pre-norm attention sublayer has normalized its input and computed attention output y. Which value should the residual connection add to y?

options.A: The encoder output, regardless of which block is running.
options.B: The attention weights summed across all token positions.
options.C: The normalized input with the original input discarded.
options.D: The original input x from before normalization.

questions.explanation: Pre-norm uses x + Attention(Norm(x)); the residual branch carries the original x unchanged.

questions.text:
Which rewrite changes this post-norm sublayer to pre-norm?

```python
out = norm(x + ffn(x))
```
questions.explanation: Pre-norm applies normalization to the sublayer input, then adds the sublayer output to the original residual input x.
